nodes.name: file_extractor.rs
nodes.summary: File read, edit, apply_patch, and delete-file extractors that convert raw tool call args/results into structured ExtractedFileData for the rendering layer.

nodes.name: extract_file
nodes.summary: Extracts and normalizes file-read tool call args/results into ExtractedFileData for display, resolving the file path and content across multiple possible field names.

nodes.name: read_line_metadata
nodes.summary: Parses optional line-range metadata (start/end line numbers) from a read tool call's arguments.

nodes.name: normalize_edit
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw file-edit payload into a canonical old/new text pair for diffing.

nodes.name: extract_edit
nodes.summary: Extracts and normalizes file-edit tool call args/results, producing before/after content and diff metadata for the edit display.

nodes.name: extract_apply_patch
nodes.summary: Parses an apply_patch tool call's unified patch text into structured edit segments for rendering.

nodes.name: extract_real_apply_patch_result
nodes.summary: Extracts the actual outcome of an apply_patch tool execution, distinguishing per-file success/failure segments from the raw result payload.

nodes.name: segment_to_edit
nodes.summary: Converts a single apply_patch result segment into an ExtractedEditData entry, attaching diff and language-detection metadata.

nodes.name: git_artifacts.rs
nodes.summary: Thin re-export shim exposing the canonical `parse_git_artifacts` Git artifact parser from `orgtrack_core` to the live event pipeline, so live capture, imported history, and DB backfill cannot diverge.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `pub use` re-export to keep a single canonical parser implementation shared across multiple ingestion paths.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Collection of defensive helpers for extracting typed values (strings, numbers, bools, arrays) from serde_json Values/Maps and parsing diff-fence metadata, used across all rendering-data extractors.

nodes.name: safe_str
nodes.summary: Recursively coerces a JSON value (string, nested object with content/text/message, or array) into a plain string.

nodes.name: parse_diff_start_lines
nodes.summary: Parses the starting line numbers of hunks out of a unified diff string for use in edit metadata.

nodes.name: obj_string_array
nodes.summary: Reads a named field from a JSON object as an array of strings, tolerating scalar or missing values.

nodes.name: parse_json_object_string
nodes.summary: Attempts to parse a string field as an embedded JSON object, returning None on parse failure.

nodes.name: normalized_result_object
nodes.summary: Normalizes a tool result payload into a plain JSON object regardless of whether it is wrapped in a success/failure envelope.

nodes.name: get_success_data
nodes.summary: Extracts the 'success' branch of a tool result payload as a JSON object, handling multiple result envelope shapes.

nodes.name: get_failure_data
nodes.summary: Extracts the 'failure'/error branch of a tool result payload as a JSON object, handling multiple result envelope shapes.

nodes.name: lang.rs
nodes.summary: Programming-language detection from file extensions plus utilities for stripping editor-style line-number prefixes from pasted code/diff text.

nodes.name: strip_line_number_prefixes_with_start
nodes.summary: Strips leading editor-style line-number prefixes from each line of text, validating that the numbering is sequential from a given start.

nodes.name: misc_extractor.rs
nodes.summary: Extractors for thinking, message, todo, web_search, subagent, delete_file, and the org_task tool family, converting raw tool args/results into their respective ExtractedData variants.

nodes.name: extract_thinking
nodes.summary: Extracts reasoning/thinking tool call content into ExtractedThinkingData.

nodes.name: extract_todo
nodes.summary: Parses a todo-list tool call's args/result into a structured list of todo items, handling multiple raw todo array encodings.

nodes.name: parse_embedded_todo_array
nodes.summary: Parses a todo array that has been embedded as a JSON string within a result field.

nodes.name: extract_web_search
nodes.summary: Extracts a web_search tool call's query and result entries into ExtractedWebSearchData.

nodes.name: extract_org_task_item
nodes.summary: Extracts a single org_task list item's fields (id, title, status, etc.) from a raw JSON value.

nodes.name: extract_org_task_args_item
nodes.summary: Extracts a single org_task item from the tool call's pre-execution `args` payload.

nodes.name: org_task_error_message
nodes.summary: Derives a user-facing error message for a failed org_task operation from the raw failure payload.

nodes.name: legacy_task_rejection_guidance
nodes.summary: Builds guidance text explaining why a legacy-format task operation was rejected.

nodes.name: org_task_operation_outcome
nodes.summary: Determines the overall outcome (success/rejected/error) of an org_task operation and attaches relevant messaging.

nodes.name: extract_org_task
nodes.summary: Extracts a full org_task tool call (args + result) into ExtractedOrgTaskData, combining item parsing and operation-outcome resolution.

nodes.name: extract_subagent
nodes.summary: Extracts a subagent-spawning tool call's args/result into ExtractedSubagentData, including the delegated task and outcome.

nodes.name: extract_delete_file
nodes.summary: Extracts a delete_file tool call's args/result into ExtractedDeleteFileData.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Public entry point for the rendering-data extractors module; registers the dispatch hook mapping SessionEvent function names to their extractor so downstream code renders events with zero JSON parsing at display time.

nodes.name: search_extractor.rs
nodes.summary: Extractors for search, glob, and list_dir tool calls, converting raw args/results into structured match/entry lists for display.

nodes.name: extract_search
nodes.summary: Extracts a text-search tool call's query, path scope, and result matches into ExtractedSearchData.

nodes.name: extract_glob
nodes.summary: Extracts a glob/file-pattern tool call's pattern and matched file list into structured data.

nodes.name: parse_text_entries
nodes.summary: Parses raw text-based search-result lines into structured entries (file, line number, snippet).

nodes.name: extract_list_dir
nodes.summary: Extracts a directory-listing tool call's path and entries (files/dirs) into ExtractedListDirData.

nodes.name: shell_extractor.rs
nodes.summary: Extractors for shell command execution and its async await_output continuation, deriving command, output, exit status, and any git artifacts produced from tool payloads.

nodes.name: extract_shell
nodes.summary: Extracts a shell-command tool call's command, output, and exit status into ExtractedShellData, including any git artifacts produced.

nodes.name: extract_await
nodes.summary: Extracts an await_output tool call (polling a previously started shell command) into ExtractedShellData.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Compatibility re-export shim exposing the canonical extracted-rendering-data types from `core_types::extracted` under the legacy `extractors::types` path.
